sections.name: Juliette Peirce and Peirce family correspondence

topics.name: Probability and induction
topics.line: probability, chance and the doctrine of chances; induction and inductive reasoning; probable inference; random samples, statistics and frequencies in the long run; the theory of errors of observation and least squares; the probability of a conclusion

topics.name: Abduction, hypothesis and the method of science
topics.line: abduction, retroduction and hypothesis; scientific method and inquiry; the economy of research; verification; explanation of surprising facts

topics.name: Deductive logic: syllogism, propositions, inference
topics.line: the syllogism and its figures, deduction, propositions and terms, the copula, premisses and conclusion, validity of inference, logical fallacies

topics.name: Logic of relatives and the algebra of logic
topics.line: the logic of relatives, relative terms, dyadic and triadic relations, the algebra of logic, Boolean algebra, quantifiers, Schröder and De Morgan

topics.name: Existential graphs
topics.line: existential graphs, the sheet of assertion, cuts and enclosures, lines of identity, the graphist and the interpreter, scribing and erasing graphs, rules of transformation

topics.name: Signs and semiotics
topics.line: signs, icon, index and symbol, the object and the interpretant of a sign, representamen, the classification of signs, meaning and signification

topics.name: Pragmatism and pragmaticism
topics.line: pragmatism and pragmaticism, the pragmatic maxim, the meaning of a concept in its conceivable practical bearings, habits of action, belief and doubt

topics.name: Categories and phenomenology
topics.line: firstness, secondness and thirdness, the categories, phenomenology or phaneroscopy, quality, reaction and mediation, monads, dyads and triads

topics.name: Cosmology, chance and continuity
topics.line: cosmology and the evolution of the universe, tychism, synechism and agapism, absolute chance, the growth of law and habit in nature, continuity

topics.name: Metaphysics: realism and nominalism
topics.line: metaphysics, realism and nominalism, universals and generals, reality and existence, being, Scotus and Ockham

topics.name: Mind, perception and psychology
topics.line: mind and consciousness, feeling, perception, sensation, attention, the self, will and effort, association of ideas, psychology

topics.name: Ethics, aesthetics and the normative sciences
topics.line: ethics and right conduct, the summum bonum, self-control, ideals, aesthetics and the admirable, the normative sciences

topics.name: Religion and God
topics.line: religion, God and the reality of God, theology, faith, the church and Christianity, prayer, the neglected argument

topics.name: Classification of the sciences
topics.line: the classification of the sciences, the branches of science, mathematics, philosophy and the special sciences, the order of the sciences

topics.name: Mathematics
topics.line: mathematics: numbers and arithmetic, geometry and topology, multitude and collections, infinity and the continuum, algebra, theorems and their proofs

topics.name: History of science and of thought
topics.line: the history of science and of ideas: ancient astronomy, Greek mathematics and philosophers, medieval learning, Kepler, Galileo, Newton, great men

topics.name: Other philosophers: Plato, Aristotle, Kant and others
topics.line: the history of philosophy: Plato and Aristotle, the scholastics, Descartes, Leibniz, Kant, Hegel, Mill, the doctrines of other philosophers

topics.name: Physics and astronomy
topics.line: physics: mechanics and force, gravitation, light and its spectra, heat and electricity, the stars and the observations of astronomers, physical instruments

topics.name: Measurement and metrology
topics.line: measurement and metrology: standards of length and of mass, the metre, the yard and the foot, comparing a wave-length of light with the metre, weights and measures, determinations of gravity with the pendulum, geodesy and the figure of the earth, the precision of measures, photometry and the measurement of sensation

topics.name: Words, grammar and definitions
topics.line: words and their meanings, etymology, grammar, language, definitions, terminology and the ethics of terminology
